entry.title: Wits and UJ researchers show early-warning systems for disengaged students are often tested unfairly
entry.summary:
Abaphandi baseYunivesithi yaseWitwatersrand neYunivesithi yaseJohannesburg, kuphepha-ndaba lokuqala olungekahlolwa ngabahlobo bezifundo, babonisa ukuba iinkqubo zesilumkiso sangaphambili zabafundi abayekayo ukubandakanyeka zihlolwa ngolwazi ebelingayi kubakho ngempela ngexesha kwenziwa uqikelelo, nto leyo eyenza iinkqubo zibonakale zingcono kunoko beziya kuba kuko ekusetyenzisweni kokwenyani. Ngokuvavanya iindlela ezintathu zoqikelelo kwiiqikelelo ezingama-49 329 zeveki ngeveki zexesha langempela ezisuka kwiirekhodi zeMoodle, bafumanisa ukuba akukho ndlela inye eyoyisa kuyo yonke imilinganiselo, kwaye ukuthoba umgangatho wesilumkiso kufumana abafundi abaninzi abasemngciphekweni kodwa kunyusa amaxilongo obuxoki ekufuneka abasebenzi balandele.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Oku kubalulekile kumsebenzi weNtsika 2 kaWits AHEAD ngohlalutyo oluqikelelayo lwempumelelo yabafundi kuba kunika iiyunivesithi zoMzantsi Afrika indlela enyanisekileyo yokugqiba, phambi kokuxhomekeka kuyo, enoba inkqubo yesilumkiso sangaphambili iya kunceda ngokwenene ukufumana ngexesha abafundi abayekayo ukubandakanyeka, kungekhona nje ukuba ibonakala njani emva kwexesha.

entry.title: Generative AI access does not mean equal use, study of Chinese, Japanese and Mongolian students finds
entry.summary:
Uphononongo oluthelekisa abafundi abangu-42 abaseyunivesithi, omnye kwiyunivesithi nganye eChina, eJapan naseMongolia, lufumanise ukuba ukufikelela kwi-AI evelisayo kuphela akuthethi ukuba iya kuba luncedo ngokulinganayo ekufundeni. Abaphandi baseYunivesithi yaseOsaka, iYunivesithi yaseMinnesota, iYunivesithi yaseWaseda kunye neYunivesithi yaseKyoto bachaza ukuba abafundi baseChina babetshintshela phakathi kweenkqubo ze-AI zasekhaya nezehlabathi, abafundi baseJapan basebenzisa ngakumbi izixhobo zehlabathi ngolwimi lwesiJapan, logama abafundi baseMongolia bebesoloko betshintshela kwisiNgesi xa iimpendulo zolwimi lwesiMongolia zibonakala zibuthathaka; onke amaqela amathathu avavanya ukuchaneka, imfihlo, ukuxhomekeka kunye nefuthe kwingqiqo yabo encamisayo phambi kokuba bathembele kwimpendulo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Oku kuyisilumkiso kumsebenzi weNtsika 1 kaWits AHEAD ngendlela i-AI evelisayo ekwimfundo ephakamileyo: ulwimi neemeko zobugcisa zendawo, kungekhona nje ukufikelela, kuko oku kugqibayo ukuba ingaba i-AI evelisayo inceda ngokwenene abafundi ukuba bafunde, isifundo esisebenza ngqo kwiinkqubo zeeyunivesithi ezineelwimi ezininzi, ezingalawulwa sisiNgesi, kuMzantsi weHlabathi uphela.

arXiv (preprint) · Preprint (not yet peer-reviewed)

entry.title: Kyoto University framework offers universities a safer way to share student data with researchers
entry.summary:
Abaphandi baseYunivesithi yaseKyoto bacebisa i-ReLEAF, uhlaka oluvumela iiyunivesithi kunye neeplatifomu zokufunda kwi-intanethi ukwabelana ngedata yokufunda abayiqokelelayo nabaphandi abangaphandle, bekwenza ngcono ukukhusela imfihlo yabafundi. Kuqala inika abaphandi idata eyenziweyo ekhuselekileyo yokuphonononga, emva koko kufikelelo olulawulwayo kwidata yokwenyani kuphela xa kuvunyelwene nesikhundla esinedata ngemfuno ethile yophando. Le yilo yahlelwa kwaye yavavanywa kwimijikelo emininzi yomsebenzi kunye nabagcini bedata, abaphandi kunye nabafundi kwiiyunivesithi zaseJapan.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Oku kubalulekile kumsebenzi weNtsika 5 kaWits AHEAD ngohlalutyo nedata yeenkqubo zemfundo kuba iiyunivesithi ezininzi, kuquka nakuMzantsi weHlabathi, zinedata eninzi yabafundi kodwa zingenayo inkqubo ekhuselekileyo evunyelweneyo yokuyabelana nabaphandi; oku kunikezela ngomzekelo osebenzayo amaziko anokuwalungelelanisa.

entry.title: UNESCO opens global consultation on governing AI so that education remains a common good
entry.summary:
I-UNESCO ivule uthethathethwano lwehlabathi jikelele, oluya kuqhubeka kude kube kwiNovemba 2026, imema abafundisi-ntsapho noongqondi bemigaqo-nkqubo ukuba baphawule kumaphepha asisiseko ngolawulo lwe-AI kwimfundo. Iphepha eliphambili, elikhululwe ngaphambi kweVeki yokuFunda kwedijithali ka-2026, licacisa iindlela ezintandathu iinjongo zemfundo zinganxulunyaniswa kabi uxa ukusetyenziswa kwe-AI kungalawulwa, kwaye ibonisa ukuba imfundo kufuneka ihlale ilungelo loluntu, kunokuba ulawulo lwayo lushiyelwe abanikezeli be-AI.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Olu thethathethwano luya kubumba izikhokelo ze-UNESCO ezizayo ezijolise kuMasipala neeyunivesithi, nto leyo eyenza ibe sisicelo esibalulekileyo seNtsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI enembopheleleko, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano nomgaqo-nkqubo, ngakumbi kumaziko akuMzantsi weHlabathi anamandla amancinci okuyila amaqhinga alawula i-AI abo.

UNESCO · Intergovernmental body, consultation paper

entry.title: Simple digital markers could flag at-risk first-year computer science students by week five, Southern African study finds
entry.summary:
Ngokuhlalutya amaqela amane abafundi bonyaka wokuqala kwisayensi yekhompyutha kwiyunivesithi enkulu karhulumente kuMzantsi weSahara, abaphandi bafumanise ukuba umlinganiselo osindwa wokuqhubeka kwezifundo, udibene nedatha elula yedemografi kunye nokuba umfundi wakhe wangena na kwinqanaba lokufunda ekwi-intanethi lemodyuli, ubonise ngokuchanekileyo ipesenti 87 yabafundi ebeza kusilela. Ababhali bathi loo mzekelo lula ngokwaneleyo ukuba usetyenziswe njengenqanaba lesilumkiso kwangethuba kususela kwiveki yesihlanu yexesha lesifundo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Isixhobo esilula sesilumkiso kwangethuba esingafuni idatha eninzi silungele iiyunivesithi ezingenazo ii-infrastructure zedatha ezaneleyo, nto leyo ixhasa ngokuthe ngqo iNtsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI noHlalutyo oluqikelelayo lwempumelelo yabafundi kwiindawo ezinqongopheleyo zoncedo.

arXiv (preprint) · Preprint (not yet peer-reviewed)

entry.title: Nigerian study finds male pre-service STEM teachers report higher AI literacy than female peers
entry.summary:
Uphononongo olwenziwe kubafundi abangama-541 abaqeqeshelwa ukuba ootitshala bezifundo zeSTEM e-Lagos State University, olupapashwe kwijenali ethi STEM Education, lufumanise ukuba ukuqonda kwabo nge-AI kuphezulu ngokwempendulo yabo, kwaye ukuqonda i-AI kuxela kakuhle indlela eya kusetyenziswa ngayo kufundisa. Uphononongo kananjalo lufumanise umahluko obalulekile ngokwesini, apho ootitshala abangamadoda bachaza ukuqonda kwabo nge-AI kuphezulu kunootitshala abangabasetyhini abathe baba nenxaxheba kuphononongo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Lo mahluko ubalulekile kumabhongo okuqeqesha ootitshala kuMzantsi weHlabathi afuna ukuba ukuqonda nge-AI kusasazeke ngokulinganayo kusizukulwana esilandelayo sootitshala beSTEM, umba ophambili weNtsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI kunye noHlalutyo lwedatha kwimfundo yeSTEM nemfundo yootitshala.

STEM Education (AIMS Press) · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Universities in Korea, Singapore and the United Kingdom take different paths to redesign teaching for AI

category.term: Korea, Singapore and the United Kingdom

entry.summary:
I-Korea Times ixela ukuba iiyunivesithi zaseKorea zongeze izithuba ezingaphezu kwe-4,000 kwiindawo ze-AI kunye nezifundo ezinxulumene nemizobo yombane ukusukela ngo-2024, kunye nokuba izicelo zokungena kwiiyunivesithi ezingamashumi amabini ezinkulu ze-AI zinyuke ngama-16% kulo nyaka, ngoxa urhulumente kufuneka anyanzele umda wezithuba ezintsha zobugcisa obuphezulu ku-434 ngo-2027 ngenxa yokunqongophala kwabasebenzi kunye nezixhobo. Inqaku elinye lithelekisa ukukhula oku kunye neYunivesithi yeTekhnoloji yaseNanyang ePhakathi kweSingapore, elicwangcise ukudibanisa i-AI kuma-40% ezifundo zayo zesidanga sokuqala ngo-2030, kunye neKing's College London kunye neLondon School of Economics, eziphinda ziyile uvavanyo kwaye zinika abafundi kunye nabasebenzi ufikelelo olunemvume kwizixhobo ze-AI kunokubuyela kuviwo olubhalwe ngesandla.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, lo mthelekiso ubonisa iimpendulo ezimbini ezahlukeneyo kuxinezelelo olufanayo, ukwakha amandla engeziweyo e-AI okanye ukuphinda uyile into kunye nendlela abafundi abavavanywa ngayo, ukhetho ekwaluphengulula ngaxesha linye iiyunivesithi zoMzantsi Afrika.

The Korea Times · Established national press, first instalment of a three-part series

entry.title: Study proposes voice-based AI interviews as a richer alternative to end-of-semester course surveys
entry.summary:
Abaphandi abasuka kwiYunivesithi yobuGcisa yeMunich kunye ne-MIT Sloan School of Management bacebisa ukutshintsha uphononongo olubhaliweyo lokuphela kwesemestara ngodliwano-ndlebe olucwangcisiweyo olwenziwa ngumqondisi we-AI othethayo, onako ukubuza imibuzo elandelayo apho ifom ebhaliweyo ingenako. Uvavanyo lobugcisa kwiYunivesithi yobuGcisa yeMunich lubonise ukuba udliwano-ndlebe lwe-AI ngomnxeba luyenzeka, kwaye ababhali ngoku bacwangcisa uphononongo olupheleleyo lwentsimi kwikhosi ye-MIT Sloan enabafundi abalingana nama-60, baxoxa iimpendulo ngokucacileyo, ubutyebi bomxholo, umoya owakhayo kunye nokunzulu kwesimo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, lo phononongo ubonisa indlela esebenzayo yokusebenzisa i-AI yoncoko ngaphakathi kokufundisa: ukuguqula imvuselelo ebuthathaka kwaneempendulo ezimbalwa ibe yinto eneenkcukacha ezaneleyo ukuba ootitshala kunye namaziko benze isigqibo.

Technical University of Munich and the MIT Sloan School of Management, posted to arXiv · Preprint (not yet peer-reviewed)

entry.title: Eduvos academic leader tells CNBC Africa that equal access to AI, not only AI literacy, will decide graduate employability
entry.summary:
Kwindibano yobukrelekrele bokwenziwa ye-CNBC Africa, inkokeli yezemfundo esuka kwiEduvos, iziko lemfundo ephakamileyo elizimele, ithe iiyunivesithi zoMzantsi Afrika azisenakho ukulinda ukuba zigqibe ukuba yintoni ebonakaliswa yi-AI kufundisa nabafundi, kwaye ulwazi lwe-AI, oko kukuthi ukwazi ukuba xa mele kuxhomekeke kwi-AI naxa mele ucinge ngokwakho, ngoku lubalulekile kangangokuba lulingana nolwazi lwemfundo esisiseko. Le nkokeli ilumkise ukuba ukufikelela kwi-AI akukho kufikelela kwisidanga kuphela: ngaphandle kwenkxaso yedijithali, iziseko kwaneeqhaga kubafundi abasuka kwiindawo ezinganezo zincomekileyo, i-AI inokukhulisa esikhundleni sokunciphisa ukungalingani phakathi kwabo baphumelele izidanga abangena entshukumweni yemisebenzi.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga nesakhono sabo baphumelele izidanga, ukuqesheka kunye notshintsho olunobulungisa, udliwano-ndlebe lukhumbuza ukuba ukulungela i-AI kwimfundo ephakamileyo yoMzantsi Afrika kuxhomekeke kakhulu kufikelelo olulinganayo kwizixhobo kunye neeziseko kanye njengoko kuxhomekeke kufundisa izakhono ze-AI.

CNBC Africa · Broadcast interview, major African business channel

entry.title: Seven-country study finds universities at very different stages of AI readiness
entry.summary:
Uphononongo olwenziwe kumazwe asixhenxe ngu-WISE kunye ne-Institute of International Education lufumanise ukuba iiyunivesithi zikwinqanaba elahlukileyo ngokubanzi kwindlela zokulungela i-AI eveliswayo, apho umgaqo-nkqubo, imvakalelo yabafundi kunye noluhlu lwezixhobo konke kungalinganiselani. Kwiyunivesithi enye yabucala eGhana, iipesenti ezingama-64 zootitshala zichaza ukuba zinomgaqo-nkqubo wecacileyo we-AI, kuthelekiswa neepesenti ezingama-27 kwiyunivesithi karhulumente yophando, nangona iipesenti ezingama-89 zootitshala kolu phononongo bebekade bayisebenzisa i-AI ngokwabo ngaphambili. Abaphandi balumkisa ukuba, ekubeni iimodeli eziphambili ze-AI ziqeqeshwa ikakhulu ngesiNgesi nazinye iilwimi eziphetheyo, amaziko ase-Afrika kunye namanye aseMzantsi weHlabathi asesichengeni sokuhlala esebenzisa i-AI kuphela, kungengoyakhi yona.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI enoxanduva, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo, olu phononongo lubonisa ukuba umsantsa wokulungela phakathi kwamaziko, kungekuphela phakathi kwamazwe, usenokwenza ukungalingani kukhule kunokuba kunciphe kwindlela imfundo ephakamileyo isamkela ngayo i-AI.

WISE and the Institute of International Education (IIE), reported by University World News · Established higher education press, reporting a WISE/IIE policy brief

entry.title: Dutch minister calls AI-written theses 'fraud', universities say detection scores cannot prove it
entry.summary:
Uphononongo olwenziwe ngumasa osasaza waseNetherlands kwiidisathesi ezingamakhulu zabafundi be-master kwiiyunivesithi ezilishumi elinazibini lufumanise ukuba kwidisathesi enye ethile kwiidisathesi ezintlanu, iibhothi zokuncokola ezifana ne-ChatGPT, i-Claude okanye i-Gemini zibhale isixa esingaphezulu sombhalo kunomfundi ngokwakhe. UMphathiswa wezeMfundo, uRianne Letschert, uthi oku bubuqhophololo, kodwa umbutho omele iiyunivesithi zaseNetherlands, iUniversiteiten van Nederland, uthi inqaku lokubonwa lodwa alinakungqina ukungaziphathi kakuhle, kwaye umbuzo wokwenyani ngendlela oviwo lwenziwa ngayo. IiYunivesithi zaseDelft, eUtrecht nase Leiden ngazimnye zithintele okanye zalele ukusetyenziswa kwezixhobo zokubona i-AI kumsebenzi wabafundi, zithi azithembakali.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI eveliswayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, impixano le ibonisa indlela ingxabano yobunyani bezemfundo enokutshintsha ngokukhawuleza ibe yeyopolitiko xa uMphathiswa engenelela, kwaye kungoko iqela lithethelela ukuphinda kuyilwe uvavanyo kunokuthembela kwisoftware yokubona.

Times Higher Education · Established higher education press

entry.title: Russell Group students say they are taught little about AI, Bett UK survey finds
entry.summary:
Uphononongo lwe-Bett UK kubafundi bomnyaka wokuqala abangaphezu kwe-1,000 e-UK lufumanise ukuba iipesenti ezingama-77 zabafundi kwiiyunivesithi ze-Russell Group zithi zifundiswa okuncinci okanye akukho nto ngokuphathelele i-AI, kuthelekiswa neepesenti ezingama-64 kwiiyunivesithi ze-post-1992. Olu phononongo lufumene kananjalo ukuba iipesenti ezingama-78 zabafundi bangawuxhasa esiqulathweni ngobuchwepheshe ngomfundi ngamnye nothatha ixesha elincinci, ngeli xesha kuphela iipesenti ezingama-34 eziva ukuba iyunivesithi yazo ibithembeke kubo malunga nokulindelekileyo ngokwenyani emva kokuphumelela. I-Russell Group ithe amalungu ayo aphinda ayile iinkqubo zokufunda kunye nemithetho yoviwo ngenxa yoku.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwiintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI eveliswayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, ukufumaniseka kokuba iiyunivesithi ezigxile kuphando kakhulu zifundisa ubuchule be-AI kancinci kunamanye amaziko kuphakamisa umbuzo othe ngqo wolingano: ngubani kubo baphumelele izidanga abangena belungele kwimarike yemisebenzi eguqulwe yi-AI.

Times Higher Education · Established higher education press

entry.title: New framework guides statistics and data science educators on teaching responsible generative AI use
entry.summary:
Iqela labafundisi-ntsapho be-statistics kunye ne-data science bapapashe uhlaka olunezahluko zine, ukuqonda, uphuhliso, ingxelo kunye nokhuseleko, ukukhokela indlela abafundisi-ntsapho abafundisa abafundi ngayo ukusebenzisa izixhobo ze-AI evelisayo ngoxanduva kwinkqubo yekhowudi kunye nohlalutyo lwe-statistics. Ilungiselelwe ngokusebenzisa iiworkshop kunye neembono zabafundi, kwaye sele isetyenziswe kwikhosi yakwi-intanethi evulekileyo enkulu kunye nokufundisa kwabafundi be-undergraduate kunye ne-postgraduate.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Intsika 3, i-AI kunye nohlalutyo kwimfundo ye-STEM kunye nemfundo yootitshala, ifuna uhlaka olulungele igumbi lokufundela, ingekuko kuphela amazwi omgaqo-nkqubo; oku kunika iWits AHEAD umzekelo osebenzayo wokufundisa ulwazi lwe-AI evelisayo ngaphakathi kwesayensi enamanani.

arXiv · Preprint (not yet peer-reviewed)

entry.title: New tool scrambles assignment images so AI reading systems fail, but people can still read them
entry.summary:
Abaphandi bakhe i-AIRRI, isixhobo esitshintsha imifanekiso yemisebenzi eshicilelweyo ngokuguqula isithuba, ukubonakala kanye nengxolo yomfanekiso, kunye nokuhlaselwa okuphikisanayo, ukwenzela ukuba izixhobo ze-OCR kunye nee-chatbot ze-AI zisokole ukubhala kwakhona lo mbhalo, ngelixa umfundi oliqabane esakwazi ukufunda ngendlela eqhelekileyo. Xa yavavanywa kuxhomekeke kwiinkqubo zokufunda ezintathu, uhlaselo olunamandla kunene lwenza izinga leempazamo zoonobumba lenyuka ukusuka ku-2.3% ukuya ku-100%, kunye nezinga leempazamo zamagama enye inkqubo lenyuka ukusuka ku-24.9% ukuya ku-96.7%. Iqela laphinda lakhupha ulwazi lwemisebenzi yemfundo ephakamileyo ukuvavanya le ndlela.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Intsika 1, i-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo: ukufundisa, uvavanyo kunye nengqibelelo, ifuna ukhuseleko olusebenza kwinqanaba lomsebenzi ngokwawo; iWits AHEAD ibukele izixhobo ezifana nesi ukubona ukuba ingqibelelo inokwakhiwa kwizixhobo zekhosi kunokuba ilandelwe emva kwexesha.

arXiv · Preprint (not yet peer-reviewed)

entry.title: New framework argues the cost of AI essay-marking systems should be measured against trustworthy scores, not efficiency alone
entry.summary:
Iphepha elitsha licebisa uhlaka “Loyilo Lokulinganisa Oluqwalasela Iindleko” lweenkqubo zokunika amanqaku kwiindaba ngesixhobo esizenzekelayo, lisithi iindleko zekhompyutha zokuphonononga nge-AI zihlala ziphathwa njengomba welungelelaniso lobuchwepheshe kuphela, lo gama ngokwenyani ingukhetho lokuyila ulinganiso. Uhlaka luchaza “iindleko ngenqaku elikhuselekileyo” elithelekisa iinkqubo zokunika amanqaku kuphela phakathi kweeyilo ezihlangabezana nomgangatho osezantsi wolinganiso oluthenjwayo, kuthi amandla olawulo kunye nokongamela kwaziko aphathwe njengomda kwiiyilo ezinokusetyenziswa, kungabi ziindleko ekufuneka zihlisiwe.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD ephathelele i-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, ukufundisa, uvavanyo kunye nengqibelelo, uhlaka lunika iiyunivesithi ezicinga ukusebenzisa ukunika amanqaku ngoncedo lwe-AI indlela eqinisekileyo yokubuza ukuba ingaba inkqubo etshiphu ivelisa ngokwenyani amanqaku athenjwayo, kunokugweba izixhobo zovavanyo olusenzekelayo ngesantya kunye neendleko kuphela.

arXiv (preprint) · Preprint (not yet peer-reviewed)

entry.title: Study of a South African university finds online “participation profiles” mostly track how long a learner is observed, not how engaged they are
entry.summary:
Ngokuhlalutya iirekhodi zomfundi-ikhosi ezingama-16,448 ezivela kubafundi abangama-4,599 kwiikhosi ezili-152 kwiyunivesithi karhulumente yoMzantsi Afrika, abaphandi baphonononge amanqaku asibhozo ebe esetyenziselwa “ukuthatha inxaxheba” kwi-intanethi, baye bafumanisa ukuba onke abonisa kakhulu ixesha umfundi abukelweyo ekhosini kunokuthatha kwakhe inxaxheba ngokwenyani. Emva kokulungisa lo mphumo, iqela elincinci lamanqaku lisabahlulahlula abafundi ngendlela enkulu yeempawu ezimbini kunye nendlela eneenkcukacha yeempawu ezine, kodwa ngokuzithemba okungaphantsi kuphela.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD ephathelele i-AI kunye noxhalutyo oluqikelelayo ngempumelelo yabafundi, le nto ifunyenweyo ngumyalezo othe ngqo kwiinkqubo zesilumkiso kwangethuba kunye nokugcina abafundi ezakhiweyo ngedatha yoMzantsi Afrika: ngaphandle kokuba ixesha umfundi alandelelwayo lithathelwa ingqalelo, inqaku elimphawula ngokuba “akathathi nxaxheba” linokuba ngumfundi nje obukelwe ixesha elimfutshane, hayi lowo usemngciphekweni ngokwenyani.

arXiv (preprint) · Preprint (not yet peer-reviewed)

entry.title: Study finds students who earn the same grade can have done very different amounts of their own thinking with AI help
entry.summary:
Ngokuhlalutya iincoko ezirekhodiweyo ezingama-150 phakathi kwabafundi kunye nezixhobo ze-AI evelisayo, uphononongo olutsha lufumanisa ukuba abafundi abaqhuba i-AI, abahlanganisa imveliso yayo ngokugocagocekayo, baze bayihlole ngononophelo, banokufumana inqaku elifanayo nabafundi abavumela i-AI yenze inxalenye enkulu yengcinga esikhundleni sabo, ngoko inqaku logqibela kuphela alikhombisi ukuba yimalini yomsebenzi eyeyomfundi ngokwenyani. Umbhali ubiza lo msantsa ngokuba “ubunini bolwazi” uthi ukunikwa amanqaku ngokusekelwe kuphela kwimveliso kungavuza amanqanaba ahluke kakhulu okuthatha inxaxheba komfundi ngenqaku elinye.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD ephathelele i-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, ukufundisa, uvavanyo kunye nengqibelelo, uphononongo luqinisa ingxoxo yovavanyo olujonga kananjalo indlela umfundi awasebenzisa ngayo i-AI ngexesha lomsebenzi, kungabi yimveliso yokugqibela kuphela, kuba amanqaku amabini afanayo anokufihla ukufunda okwahluke kakhulu.

arXiv (preprint) · Preprint (not yet peer-reviewed)

entry.title: Wits tells top applicants AI should make graduates indispensable, not just employable
entry.summary:
Abafundi abangaphezu kwama-200 abaphumelele kakuhle kakhulu kwiimviwo zasesekondari, abavela eGauteng nakwimimandla eyahlukeneyo, baye kuMsitho woMphathiswa oyiNqununu yaseWits Wabafaki-zicelo Abaphambili, apho umfundi wangaphambili waseWits, uGqirha Craig Wing, wanikela intetho ephambili ngobukrelekrele bokwenziwa kunye nekamva lehlabathi lomsebenzi. ISekela leNqununu, uNjingalwazi Garth Stevens, uxelele abafundi ukuba iyunivesithi ingumthwalo wembopheleleko, hayi nje indlela esa emsebenzini, kwaye uWits ufuna ukuba abo baphumelele izidanga babe ngaphezulu kokuqeshekayo nje, ufuna babe ngabangenakuphulukana nabo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kuntsika kaWits AHEAD malunga ne-AI, isakhono sabaphumelele izidanga, ukuqesheka kunye notshintsho olunobulungisa, uMsitho lo ubonisa ukuba iYunivesithi ngokwayo ilungiselela abafundi abatsha kwimarike yemisebenzi eguqulwe yi-AI kususela kudibano lwabo lokuqala neWits, kunokuba bayeke umbuzo wokuqesheka ulindele emva kokuphumelela izidanga.

Wits University · University announcement

entry.title: Study finds AI grading tools miss most student misconceptions despite accurate scores
entry.summary:
Uphononongo olutsha luphulaphule ukuba iimodeli zolwimi ezinkulu ezisebenzisa i-AI ukwenza amanqaku emisebenzi evulelekileyo kwimfundo ephakamileyo ziluncedo njengoko amanqaku awo okuchaneka abonisa. Ngokuhlalutya iimpendulo zabafundi ezingama-3,041 kwimibuzo evulelekileyo engama-50 yenzululwazi yekhompyutha, eyenziwa ngamanqaku ngootitshala babantu kunye neemodeli zolwimi ezinkulu zorhwebo ezintathu, abaphandi bafumanisa ukuba uphononongo lwe-AI lwabonisa iimpazamo zokuqonda kwabafundi kwiipesenti ezisuka kwi-5 ukuya kwi-7 kuphela, xa kuthelekiswa neepesenti ezisuka kwi-15 ukuya kwi-31 kootitshala babantu, kwaye uphononongo lwe-AI lwahlala lulungile ngaxesha zonke nokuba umgangatho wempendulo unjani. Uphononongo kananjalo lwafumanisa ukuba amanqaku amancinci e-rubric aveliswa yi-AI ayalana ngokusondeleyo kakhulu phakathi kwawo, de angafaki lwazi luncinci olungaxhomekekileyo lophando.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD ephathelele i-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, ukufundisa, uvavanyo kunye nengqibelelo, into ekufunyenwe ukuba uphononongo lwe-AI lunokubonakala lulungile ngeli xesha lushiya iimpazamo eziningi zengcinga ezibalulekileyo kufundiso, isilumkiso sokuba abantu bangathathi uphononongo olusenzelwa ngomatshini endaweni yengqondo kagqirha yotitshala.

arXiv (preprint) · Preprint (not yet peer-reviewed)

entry.title: California requires its public colleges to set AI procurement and training standards
entry.summary:
ICalifornia isayine umthetho we-Assembly Bill 2392 (AB 2392), ophoqa iinkqubo zayo ze-California Community Colleges kunye ne-California State University ukuba zidibanise iqela losebenzi eliya kucebisa ngemigangatho yokuthenga kunye noqeqesho lwabasebenzi kunye nabafundi malunga ne-AI eveliswayo, apho iingcebiso kulindeleke ukuba zifike ngoJanuwari 2028. Lo mthetho, owasayinwa ngomhla wama-30 kuSeptemba 2026 njenge-Chapter 855 ye-Statutes of 2026, uphinda ufune ukuba ezi nkqubo zombini zihlole uqeqesho lwe-AI ubuncinane kube kanye ngonyaka, kananjalo zixele kwiPalamente yombuso ngaphakathi kweentsuku ezi-60 emva kokusayina nasiphi na isivumelwano se-AI eveliswayo esichaphazela yonke inkqubo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI enoxanduva, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo, inyathelo laseCalifornia lokubeka imigangatho yokuthenga karhulumente kunye noqeqesho emthethweni, kunokuba kushiywe kwiziko ngalinye ukugqiba ngendlela esetyenziswa i-AI eveliswayo, lingumzekelo ophuma kuMntla weHlabathi wolawulo lwe-AI kwinqanaba lenkqubo iyonke, nto leyo nayo iinkqubo zemfundo ephakamileyo zoMzantsi weHlabathi zikhuthazwa ukuba ziyakhe.

California State Legislature · State legislation

entry.title: University of Johannesburg vice-chancellor: Africa needs AI governance beyond regulation
entry.summary:
Kuncokolo oluqhutyekiswayo nge-CNBC Africa, iSekela-Rhuluneli le-University of Johannesburg, uNjingalwazi Letlhokwa Mpedi, uxubusheke nomhleli ophezulu wesi qumrhu, Godfrey Mutizwa, ngoko kufunekayo ukulawula ubukrelekrele bokwenziwa (i-AI) eAfrika ngaphaya kokuphela kokuwalawula. Incoko iquka indima ekufuneka iidliwe ziiyunivesithi kunye nabenza umgaqo-nkqubo ekumiliseleni uphuhliso lwe-AI kwilizwekazi, kunokuba baphendule nje imithetho eyenziwe kwindawo yimbi.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwiintsika zeWits AHEAD ngolawulo olunembeko lwe-AI, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano nomgaqo-nkqubo, iSekela-Rhuluneli yeyunivesithi esebenzayo yoMzantsi Afrika ekhuthaza ulawulo lwe-AI olukhokelwa ngu-Afrika, ithetha ngqo kwinjongo kaWits AHEAD yokwakha amandla ka-Afrika okumisela iimeko zophuhliso lwe-AI, kunokuba ivumelane nje nohlaka olwenziwe kwindawo yimbi.

CNBC Africa · Broadcast interview, major African business channel

entry.title: Joining up AI across recruitment, retention and alumni relations can close graduation gaps, if it is governed well
entry.summary:
Ebhala kwi-University World News, umlawuli weprojekthi ye-IREX uCameron Mirza uthi iiyunivesithi kufuneka ziphathe ukuqeshwa kwabafundi, ukugcinwa kwabo kunye nobudlelwane nabaphumelele izidanga njengobomi obunye obudityanisiweyo oluxhaswa yi-AI, kunokuba ziinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezineedatha ezahlukeneyo. Ucaphula inkqubo yekhompyutha yencoko nohlalutyo oluqikelelayo yaseGeorgia State University, ekuthiwa yancitsha i-"summer melt" ngamalunga ne-21 wamaphesenti kwaye yanceda abafundi abamnyama, i-Hispanic, abokuqala kwiintsapho zabo nabobuhlwempu baphumelele ngamanqanaba alinganayo okanye angaphezulu kunabanye abafundi, ngelixa elumkisa ukuba iimodeli eziqeqeshwe ngedatha yangaphambili zinako nazo ukuqinisa ukungalingani ebezifanele ukuzilungisa.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kuluphawu lwe-Wits AHEAD olumalunga ne-AI nohlalutyo oluqikelelayo lwempumelelo yabafundi, eli nqaku likhumbuza ngokubalulekileyo ukuba izixhobo zesilumkiso kwangethuba nezokugcina abafundi zivala kuphela imisantsa yolingano xa zihambelana nokugadwa ngabantu novavanyo lokukhethwa, ngqo umbuzo wolawulo i-Wits AHEAD eyibuzayo nasiphi na isixhobo sohlalutyo esiyincomayo.

University World News · Established higher education press (commentary by a sector practitioner)

entry.title: Wits researchers argue Africa must set its own AI research agenda, not just apply others' tools
entry.summary:
Iingcali zekhompyutha ezibini kwi-University of the Witwatersrand, uBenjamin Rosman noSteve James, abaphathi abahlanganyeleyo be-Robotics, Autonomous Intelligence and Learning (RAIL) Lab, bathi uMzantsi Afrika kufuneka aqhube uphando lwabo lobukrelekrele bokwenziwa, kunokuba nje asebenzise izixhobo ezenziwe kwenye indawo. Babhekisa kwi-Deep Learning Indaba, ngoku isikolo sasehlobo esikhulu kunazo zonke se-AI ehlabathini, esatsalela abathathi-nxaxheba abayi-1,300 kumhlangano wonyaka ophelileyo eKigali, kwaye kulo nyaka iqhutyelwa inkqubo yayo i-IndabaX kumazwe angama-48 kwelowo angama-54 eAfrika, nakwi-Machine Intelligence and Neural Discovery (MIND) Institute entsha yaseWits, edibanisa iingcali ezimalunga ne-65 kwizifundo zekhompyutha, inzululwazi yobuchopho, isayikholoji nomgaqo-nkqubo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kuluphawu lwe-Wits AHEAD olumalunga ne-AI enengqiqo, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo, isilumkiso ngokuchasene noMzantsi Afrika ukuba abe "yindawo yokwenzela abanye abantu isayensi" sithetha ngqo kwinjongo kaWits AHEAD yokwakha isakhono esikhokelwa ngabantu baseAfrika sokumisela imibuzo yophando lwe-AI, kungekhona nje ukusebenzisa izixhobo ze-AI eziyilwe kwenye indawo.

Times Higher Education · Established higher education press

entry.title: Study of students in China, Japan and Mongolia finds access to generative AI does not guarantee it is useful for learning
entry.summary:
Iphepha losebenzo elifunda abafundi abafunda izidanga zabo zokuqala abangama-42 kwiyunivesithi enye ngayinye eTshayina, eJapan naseMongolia lifumanise ukuba indlela abafundi abafikelela ngayo kwi-AI evelisayo, ngokuthe ngqo, ngeeplatifomu zehlabathi, okanye ngokutshintsha ulwimi, yiyo ebalulekileyo ekubeni kube luncedo ngempela kubo, kungekhona nje ukuba banokuyifikelela. Abafundi baseMongolia, ngokomzekelo, babesoloko betshintshela kwisiNgesi xa iziphumo ngolwimi lwesiMongolia zingonelanga, ngeli xa onke amaqela amathathu ecaphula ukuchaneka, ubumfihlo, ukuxhomekeka kunye nefuthe lesixhobo kwingqondo yabo yokucinga ngokugqibeleleyo. Ababhali, uMing Li, uQin Xie, uAriunaa Enkhtur, uLilan Chen noFei Cheng, bagqiba ngelithi ukufikelela kwetekhnoloji kodwa akuqinisekisi ukusetyenziswa okulinganayo kwezemfundo kwiimeko ezahlukeneyo zolwimi netekhnoloji.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kuluphawu lwe-Wits AHEAD olumalunga ne-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, ukufunyaniswa kokuba ulwimi kunye neemeko zetekhnoloji zasekuhlaleni, kungekhona unxibelelwano kuphela, kuxa kutya ukuba i-AI evelisayo inceda ngempela abafundi bafunde, sisilumkiso i-Wits AHEAD esisebenzisa ngokulinganayo kwizixhobo ze-AI ezilawulwa sisiNgesi ezisetyenziswa kumakhampasi amaninzi olwimi oMzantsi Afrika.

arXiv (working paper) · Working paper (preprint, not yet peer-reviewed)

entry.title: South African minister tells universities to move from AI debate to decisions on teaching and research
entry.summary:
Ethetha kwiNkomfa yesine yeMfundo ePhakamileyo yeUniversities South Africa, ngomhla wesi-7 kuOkthobha 2026, uMphathiswa wezeMfundo ePhakamileyo noQeqesho, uButi Manamela, uxelele iiyunivesithi ukuba i-AI yenza umsebenzi wazo ophambili, ukufundisa ukucinga okunzulu nokuthatha uxanduva ngolwazi, ube ngxamiseke ngakumbi, kungabi nganeno, kuba iinkqubo ze-AI zinako ukudala umxholo ngokuzithemba ngaphandle kokuqinisekisa ukuba uyinyaniso. Uthi umbuzo wokwenyani ugqithisa ekubeni nje abafundi basebenzisa i-AI kwimisebenzi yesikolo, ubandakanya nokuba ngubani owenza le tekhnoloji, ziilwimi namava abantu ezibonakaliswa yiyo, ngubani olawula iziseko zobugcisa, nokuba ngubani oxhamlayo. Ukhuthaze ukuba izifundo zobuntu nezentlalo zisebenze ndawonye nobunjineli kunye nezinzululwazi zemvelo, ekujongeni iimpembelelo zayo ekucaleni, emandleni, nakwimisebenzi.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kuluphawu lwe-Wits AHEAD olumalunga ne-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, umphathiswa karhulumente obeka icebo elicacileyo, ngokufundisa, ngovavanyo kunye nobuchule bophando, kunokuba abe ngumxholo wengxoxo jikelele, unika iiyunivesithi zoMzantsi Afrika igunya elicacileyo lokuthatha amanyathelo.

South African Government News Agency (SAnews) · National government news agency

entry.title: UNESCO study finds 87% of Latin American and Caribbean universities already use AI, but only 26% have a formal strategy
entry.summary:
Iphepha losebenzo lwe-UNESCO IESALC, elidityaniswe nelwe-UNU-IAS, elaphonononga iziko zemfundo ephakamileyo 200 kumazwe 19 aseLatin America nakuCaribbean phakathi kuAgasti noku-Okthobha 2025, lifumanise ukuba iipesenti ezingama-87 sele zisebenzisa i-AI kumba omnye ubuncinane, ekhokelwa yindlela yokufundisa nokufunda (iipesenti ezingama-74) nophando (iipesenti ezingama-57), ngeli xesha iipesenti ezingama-26 kuphela zinesicwangciso esisemthethweni se-AI, kwaye iipesenti ezingama-55 azinalo nanye uhlahlo-lwabiwo-mali olunikezelwe kwi-AI. Ukusetyenziswa kunye nolawulo zombini zilandela uhlobo lweziko ngokusondeleyo: iipesenti ezingama-84 zeziko eziphantsi kwabucala ezingazimiseli ngenzuzo zisebenzisa i-AI, kuthelekiswa neepesenti ezingama-68 zeziko karhulumente, kwaye iipesenti ezingama-17 zeziko karhulumente zichaza ukungabikho kakade koqeqesho lwabasebenzi, kuthelekiswa neepesenti ezingama-3 zeziko zabucala ezingazimiseli ngenzuzo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kuluphawu lwe-Wits AHEAD olumalunga ne-AI enengqiqo, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo, ukufunyaniswa kokuba ukusetyenziswa kwe-AI sele kusasazeke ngelixa ulawulo olusemthethweni lusemva kakhulu, kwaye ngokungalinganiyo phakathi kweziko karhulumente nezabucala, kufana nomsantsa wolawulo i-Wits AHEAD eyibonayo kuMzantsi weHlabathi ngobubanzi bawo.

UNESCO IESALC and UNU-IAS, reported by Times Higher Education · Established higher education press, reporting a UNESCO/UNU-IAS working paper

entry.title: UTeach survey finds STEM teacher-training staff cautiously optimistic about AI but wary of integrity and bias risks
entry.summary:
Uphononongo lwabasebenzi beakademi, abalawuli nabasebenzi 57 abasuka kwiinkqubo 31 zokuqeqesha ootitshala beSTEM kwiikholeji neeyunivesithi 54 kuMzantsi weMelika, lufumanise ukuba iipesenti ezingama-77 zivumelana ukuba i-AI inamandla okuchaphazela umsebenzi wazo ngokuhle, ngeli xesha iipesenti ezingama-61 zizichaza njengabasebenzisi abazimiseleyo. Iipesenti ezingama-63 zisahlala zikhathazeke ngemiceli mngeni, ikakhulu ingqibelelo yezemfundo (iipesenti ezingama-42) kunye nenkolelo-ethekelelweyo yokuziphatha (iipesenti ezingama-21). Iipesenti ezingama-70 zichonge imfuneko yoqeqesho olongezelelweyo; iipesenti ezingama-79 zabafundisi sele zisebenzisa i-AI kwizifundo zabo, ikakhulu ekucwangciseni iileksoni nasekuyileni uvavanyo, kunokuba kube luphando olunzulu lwedatha yeSTEM.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kuluphawu lwe-Wits AHEAD olumalunga ne-AI nohlalutyo kwiSTEM nemfundo yootitshala, umsantsa phakathi kwabasebenzi abasele bazama i-AI nesakhelo esimanyene, esisekelwe kuphando, abathi basilele kuso, ufana ncam noluhlobo lwenkokheli eyilungeleleneyo iinkqubo zokuqeqesha ootitshala kuMzantsi weHlabathi eziya kuyidinga nazo.

The UTeach Institute, The University of Texas at Austin · University research institute report

entry.title: Systematic review finds no existing framework yet addresses the ethical and instructional challenges of AI in STEM teaching
entry.summary:
Uphononongo olucokisekileyo olwenziwe ngabaphandi be-Wentworth Institute of Technology kunye ne-University of New Haven luvavanye izakhelo ezisungulwe kudala, ezifana ne-TPACK, i-SAMR, i-ADDIE kunye ne-Universal Design for Learning, ngokuzithelekisa neemodeli zokwazi i-AI kunye nemigaqo yokusebenzisa i-AI ngendlela enengqiqo, ukubona indlela ezixhasa ngayo abafundisi beSTEM kwindlela yabo yokufundisa. Luye lufumanise ukuba akukho nesinye sezi zakhelo esele sijongana nemiceli mngeni yobungcali, yokuziphatha, kunye nokufundisa ekusetyenziseni i-AI kwimfundo yeSTEM, kwaye ukusetyenziswa kwezixhobo ze-AI kukhawuleza ngaphezu kwenkokheli ecwangcisiweyo yezokufundisa, nto leyo ekhokelela kwindlela yokwenza esekelwe ezixhobeni, kunokuba isekelwe kwisakhelo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kuluphawu lwe-Wits AHEAD olumalunga ne-AI nohlalutyo kwiSTEM nemfundo yootitshala, ukufunyaniswa kokuba akukho sakhelo sokufundisa sikhoyo esigubungela imiceli mngeni yokuziphatha nokufundisa ye-AI, komeleza isizathu sokuba iqela lenze umsebenzi walo wokudibanisa i-AI ngendlela enengqiqo, ekhethekileyo kwiSTEM.

American Society for Engineering Education (ASEE), North East Section Conference · Peer-reviewed conference paper

entry.title: More universities end Turnitin contracts as concerns mount
entry.summary:
I-Times Higher Education ibika ukuba i-Newcastle University kunye ne-University of Westminster zidibene ne-University of Southampton ekuphelisweni kwezivumelwano zazo nenkampani yokufumanisa ukukopa i-Turnitin, emva kokuba yacebisa utshintsho kwiilayisensi olwanga lwavumela umsebenzi wabafundi ukuba usetyenziswe ukuqeqesha izixhobo ze-AI. I-Newcastle yachaphazela ngqo lo mgaqo wedatha; i-Westminster yathi isixhobo sokukhangela ukukopa se-Turnitin 'besingasebenzi kakuhle' kumbhalo obhalwe yi-AI, kwaye isixhobo sayo sokufumanisa i-AI sinomngcipheko 'owaziwayo wezimpendulo ezizizo ezingezizo'. I-Southampton yodwa yahlawula i-Turnitin i-£87,621 kunyaka omnye, phakathi kwabafundi abangaphezu kwe-17,000 abaqalayo kunye nabangama-8,000 abaqhubekayo neziqu.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI enembopheleleko, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo, lo mba ubonisa ukuba ii-yunivesithi ziqalisa ukulinganisa ulawulo lwedatha kunye nokuthembeka kwenyani kwezixhobo zokufumanisa i-AI ngokumelene neendleko, kunokuba zithathe isivumelwano sokukhangela ukukopa njengembopheleleko engenakuguqulwa.

Times Higher Education · Established higher education press

entry.title: Prepare students for post-graduation AI judgement challenges
entry.summary:
I-University World News ithi indlela imfundo ephakamileyo isabela ngayo kwi-AI evelisayo iyeka kwixesha elingephanga, ngelixa abafundi befumana izidanga kuphela, ngaphambi kokuba uvavanyo lwenyani lokugweba ngobungqina lufike. Liphononongo elenziwe ngo-2026, elipapashwe kwijenali i-Organization Science, laqwalasela abacebisi abangama-758 be-Boston Consulting Group abagqibezela imisebenzi yokwenyani benento okanye bengenayo incedisi ye-AI evelisayo: kwimisebenzi emininzi iqela elisebenzisa i-AI lasebenza ngokukhawuleza nangomgangatho ophezulu, kodwa kumsebenzi omnye ongaphaya kobuchule besixhobo, ama-70.6 ekhulwini kuphela abacebisi abasebenzisa i-AI abafikelela impendulo echanekileyo, kuxhomekeke kuma-84.5 ekhulwini kwabasebenza bengenayo, kwaye abahloli abangazaziyo iimpendulo bagqiba ukuba iingxelo ezingachanekileyo ze-AI zazibonakala zinyanisekile njengezo zichanekileyo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI, isakhono sabafundi abaphumelele izidanga, ukuqesheka kunye notshintsho olunobulungisa, olu phononongo lubonisa ukuba umsebenzi wokusebenzisa i-AI ngokuzithemba kodwa ongachanekileyo ungabonakala unyanisekile njengowo uchanekileyo, nto leyo ebonisa ukuba kufuneka ukugweba ngobungqina, kungenjalo kuphela ulwazi lwe-AI, kuba sisakhono abaphumelele izidanga abasidinga ngakumbi phambi kokungena kwimarike yemisebenzi.

University World News · Established higher education press, commentary citing a peer-reviewed field experiment

entry.title: UNESCO and Codemao's AI coding drive reaches more African classrooms
entry.summary:
I-UNESCO kunye neplatform yeTshayina yokubhala iinkqubo zekhompyutha, i-Codemao, bathi iprojekthi yabo edibeneyo yokufundisa ulutsha ukubhala iinkqubo iyaqhubeka ikhula e-Afrika. Isigaba sesibini, esiya kuqhubeka kude kube ku-2030, sele sifundise ootitshala abangama-200 eRiphablikhi yaseCongo, eKenya, eNamibia naseThailand, apho ama-45% yabo ingabasetyhini, kwaye iKenya inikwe ii-tablet ezingama-200 kuzikolo zesekondari eziyama-20 ezimaphakathi.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI kunye nohlalutyo lwedatha kwimfundo yeSTEM kunye nemfundo yootitshala, le projekthi ibonisa umzekelo wokwakha izakhono ze-AI nokubhala iinkqubo zekhompyutha phakathi kootitshala kuMzantsi weHlabathi, ngokukodwa kubasetyhini.

Xinhua (New China TV) · Major international news agency, video report

entry.title: PISA 2025 finds AI chatbot use split with student learning outcomes
entry.summary:
Uvavanyo lwe-PISA 2025 lwe-OECD, olukuqala kukhangela ukusetyenziswa kwe-AI, luvavanyile abafundi abangaphezu kwe-760,000 abaneminyaka yobudala eli-15 kumazwe ali-91. Lufumanise ukuba ukuxhomekeka ngokugqithisileyo kwii-chatbot ze-AI ukubhala umsebenzi wesikolo kunxulumene namanqaku aphantsi kwinzululwazi, ngelixa ukusetyenziswa okulinganiselweyo nokukhokelweyo kubonisa iipateni ezahlukileyo nezingcono; amanqaku okufunda nemathematika nawo awele kakhulu kumazwe e-OECD ekudeni leminyaka elishumi edlulileyo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, ukufundisa, uvavanyo kunye nengqibelelo yezemfundo, oku ngumqondiso wokuqala wendlela abafundi abaza kuyiphatha xa befikile kwiyunivesithi, nokuya kufuneka kufundiswe nokuvavanywe kuyo.

OECD (via Newsweek) · Intergovernmental body's flagship international assessment, reported by established press

entry.title: Understanding ethical dimensions of AI in higher education: insights from faculty members and students
entry.summary:
Uphononongo olusebenzisa iindlela ezixubeneyo lubuzile abafundi abali-971 kunye nabasebenzi bemfundo abali-135, emva koko lwenza udliwano-ndlebe nabafundi abali-23 nootitshala abali-14, malunga neendlela zokuziphatha ze-AI kwimfundo ephakamileyo. Amaqela omabini ayavumelana ngokubanzi ukuba i-AI kufuneka isetyenziswe ngendlela enembopheleleko, kodwa iimbono zawo zahluka: ootitshala bagxininisa imigaqo yokuziphatha kodwa bathi iiziko zabo zisweleka izikhokelo, ngelixa abafundi bafumanisa i-AI iluncedo ekufundeni kodwa bengaqinisekile ukuba imbopheleleko yabo iyafikelela phi.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI enembopheleleko, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo, iingcebiso zoluphononongo, uqeqesho lwabasebenzi, izifundo zemigaqo yokuziphatha ezizimeleyo, kunye nezikhokelo zeyunivesithi ezicacileyo, zinika uluhlu olusebenzayo kumaziko angekabi nawo umgaqo-nkqubo osesikweni wemigaqo yokuziphatha ye-AI.

International Journal of Educational Technology in Higher Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: From AI literacy to action: South Africa charts a path forward for teacher education
entry.summary:
ISebe lezemfundo ephakamileyo nokuqeqeshwa laseMzantsi Afrika kunye ne-Commonwealth of Learning babambe inkomfa yoqeqesho yesizwe yeentsuku ezibini malunga ne-AI kwimfundo yootitshala, kwikampasi ye-Future Africa yeYunivesithi yasePitoli. Abafundisi-ntsapho, abenzi-mgaqo-nkqubo kunye neenkokeli zenkqubo bavumelana ngendlela yomgaqo-nkqubo wesizwe oguqukayo esekelwe kumgaqo, baze baseka iqela losebenzi lesizwe, iziphumo zinjongelwe ukufaka esihlolweni esiqhubekayo seMinimum Requirements for Teacher Education Qualifications, abathathi-nxaxheba baphawula ukuba ngoku asithethi nto malunga ne-AI.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI kunye nohlalutyo kwi-STEM nemfundo yootitshala, oku kubonisa inkqubo ecacileyo, ekhokelwa ngurhulumente, eguqula ulwazi lwe-AI kube ngumgaqo-nkqubo wesizwe wamanqaku kwinkqubo yemfundo yootitshala yaseMzantsi Afrika.

Commonwealth of Learning · Intergovernmental organisation report on a national government workshop

entry.title: Supporting cost-effective AI adoption in education
entry.summary:
I-World Bank ipapashe iphepha lophando elithi Costing AI Use in Education in Low- and Middle-Income Countries, kunye nombhalo weblog ocacisa indlela amasebe ezemfundo afanele ahlele ngayo uhlahlo-lwabiwo-mali lwe-AI. Licebisa ukuqalisa ngezixhobo ezinceda ootitshala, njengokucwangcisa izifundo kunye nokunika impendulo, kunokuba i-AI isasazwe kubafundi bonke ngaxeshanye, ukuthelekisa iindleko ze-AI kunye neendleko zamanje zokwandisa ufundisa oluqhelekileyo, nokusebenzisa izixhobo kunye nemithombo-nqaku yeselfowuni esele ikho ezikolweni. I-World Bank iqikelela ukuba ukufikelela kwinjongo yophuhliso oluzinzileyo lwezemfundo eMzantsi Afrika weSahara kuya kufuna ngaphezu koko i-6.4 bhiliyoni yeedola zaseMelika ngonyaka kootitshala bamabanga asezantsi kunye ne-38.7 bhiliyoni ngonyaka kootitshala bamabanga aphezulu kuzo i-2030.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga nohlalutyo kunye nedatha ekhonza iinkqubo zemfundo nokuthatha izigqibo, le ngxelo inika amasebe kunye nemiziko kuMzantsi weHlabathi isakhelo esicacileyo, esinezindleko eziqikelelweyo, sokugqiba apho inkcitho ye-AI kwimfundo iya kuba luncedo olukhulu.

World Bank · Intergovernmental body blog, summarising a World Bank working paper

entry.title: Grappling with "homework scams", US universities shun AI detectors
entry.summary:
Ingxelo ye-AFP ethwelwe yi-eNCA ichaza indlela iYale, iCornell kunye neYunivesithi yaseWisconsin-Madison ezithethelela okanye ezithintela abasebenzi bazo ukusebenzisa isoftware yokufumanisa i-AI njengobungqina bokuqhatha, emva kokuba uphononongo lufumene ukuba ezi zixhobo azithembekile kwaye zidla ngokubonisa iziphumo ezingamampunge, kuquka nakubabhali abangathethi isiNgesi njengolwimi lwabo lwenzala. Umhlohli wezibalo zendalo eWisconsin-Madison, owafihla umyalelo kumsebenzi, wabamba abafundi 60 kwi-350 abasebenzisa i-AI bengabonwa ngoqinisekiso oluqhelekile, kwaye ngoku uguqukela kuviwo lwamazwi kunye neengxoxo-mpikiswano zevidiyo kunokubhalwa kweenkumbulo; uphononongo lwe-American Association of Colleges and Universities kunye neYunivesithi yaseElon lwafumanisa ukuba 95% yabahlohli boyika ukuxhomekeka ngokugqithisileyo kwabafundi kwi-AI.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: I-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, ngakumbi uvavanyo nengqibelelo yezemfundo, yiNtsika 1 ye-Wits AHEAD, kwaye lo mhlehlo kumasofthiwe okufumanisa i-AI kwiiyunivesithi eziphambili luphawu olungqalileyo, olunempumelelo yokuba iqela kufuneka licebise njani ngokuguqulwa kovavanyo kunoko kuxhomekeke kufumaniso njengempendulo kulo kusetyenziswa gwenxa kwe-AI.

AFP (via eNCA) · Established press (wire service report)

entry.title: Global Employment Trends for Youth 2026: Back to the Future
entry.summary:
Ingxelo ye-International Labour Organization, i-Global Employment Trends for Youth 2026, ifumanise ukuba izinga lentswela-ngqesho yolutsha ehlabathini lenyukele kuma-12.4% ngo-2025, ishiya malunga nezigidi 67 zolutsha oluneminyaka 15 ukuya ku-24 lungaphangeli, ngelixa malunga nomnye kwabahlanu abaselutsha, abalinganiselwa kwizigidi 257, bengekho emsebenzini, emfundweni okanye kuqeqesho. Ingxelo iqikelela ukuba 6.1% yemisebenzi egcinwe ngulutsha olusemaminyakeni 15 ukuya ku-29 isemngciphekweni omkhulu wokutshintshwa ngumsebenzi we-AI, ikakhulukazi imisebenzi yeeofisi neyokubhala eyavakala yehlile kubasebenzi abaselutsha, kwaye ibongoza ulawulo lwe-AI kunye nobuchwepheshe olugxile ebantwini, ehamba kunye noxhaso olomeleleyo lokusingisa emsebenzini onesidima.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Ukuqesheka kwabaphumelele izidanga kunye notshintsho olunobulungisa, equka indlela i-AI eguqula ngayo imisebenzi yamanqanaba okuqala, yiNtsika 4 ye-Wits AHEAD, kwaye okufunyenweyo yile ngxelo yamazwe ngamazwe, ukuba imisebenzi yeeofisi, edla ngokuba inyathelo lokuqala kwabaphumelele izidanga, isemngciphekweni omkhulu kwi-AI, inika iqela umqathango oqinisekileyo nowehlabathi lemisebenzi yalo malunga ne-AI nokuqesheka kwabaphumelele izidanga kuMzantsi weHlabathi.

International Labour Organization · Intergovernmental body report

entry.title: Generative AI use and misuse call for assessment reform in higher education
entry.summary:
Uphononongo oluhlolwe ziingcali kwijenali ye-Science luphendlwe abafundi abangaphezu kwe-95,000 kwiiyunivesithi 20 ezinkulu zoluntu zophando eMelika, ngonyaka wezifundo we-2023-24. Lufumene ukuba 37% yabafundi basebenzisa i-AI evelisayo ubuncinane kwixesha elinye ngenyanga kumsebenzi wabo, kwaye ababhali baqikelela ukuba malunga ne-9% bayisebenzisela ukuqhatha, inani eli linyukela kuma-26% phakathi kwabasebenzisi bemihla ngemihla; ukusetyenziswa nokuqhatha kwahluka kakhulu ngokuxhomekeke kwisifundo. Ababhali babongoza utshintsho lovavanyo olufanelekileyo kwisifundo ngasinye kunokuba kubekho ukuvalwa okubanzi okanye inkqubo yokufumanisa kwiyunivesithi iphela.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: I-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, ngakumbi uvavanyo nengqibelelo yezemfundo, yiNtsika 1 ye-Wits AHEAD, kwaye okufunyenweyo kolu phononongo lukhulu, ukuba ukusetyenziswa gwenxa kwahluka ngokwesifundo kungabi kufana kuzo zonke, kunika iqela ubungqina obuqinisekileyo bokuyila utshintsho lovavanyo olufanelekileyo kwisifundo ngasinye, kunokuba kubekho inguqu yonke jikelele.

Science · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: UCT summit puts AI, inequality and future of universities in spotlight
entry.summary:
Inkomfa yeHlabathi yeZemfundo ePhakamileyo ye-Times Higher Education ivulwe kwi-University of Cape Town ngomhla wama-30 kuSeptemba 2026, okukuqala i-Afrika ibambe le nkomfa. Abantu abangama-600 abangabaphathi bezemfundo ephakamileyo, iingcali kunye nabenzi bomgaqo-nkqubo abavela kumazwe angaphezu kwama-60 bathatha inxaxheba; iSekela loMlawuli kwi-UCT, uNjingalwazi Mosa Moshabela, uthe ikamva leyunivesithi alinakucuthwa nje ekwamkeleni itekhnoloji; ngelixa uMphathiswa weZemfundo ePhakamileyo, uButi Manamela, ebiza ukuba i-AI yandise ukufikelela kwimfundo, kuxhaswe ngulwazi olubanzi malunga ne-AI kunye nokufikelela okungcono kwitekhnoloji. I-UCT iyekile ukuxhomekeka kwiisofthiwe zokufumanisa i-AI, kunoko yakha uhlaka lwayo malunga nendlela abafundi nabasebenzi abasebenzisa ngayo i-AI evelisayo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Ukufikelela kwi-AI evelisayo ngokulinganayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo yintsika yokuqala kwiintsika ezintandathu ze-Wits AHEAD, kwaye umphathiswa echaza ulwazi nge-AI, kungekhe yiisofthiwe zokufumanisa, njengemeko yokufikelela okulinganayo, kuhambelana ncam nommandla osetyenziswa ngumsebenzi womgaqo-nkqubo nokufundisa weli qela.

TimesLIVE · Established press

entry.title: Global Index on Responsible AI: 2026 Report
entry.summary:
I-Global Index on Responsible AI ka-2026, epapashwe yi-Global Center on AI Governance kwaye yasungulwa eGeneva ngoJulayi 2026, ihlole ulawulo kumazwe ali-135 isebenzisa amanqaku edatha angaphezu kwe-68,000 aqokelelwe phakathi kweNovemba 2023 kunye neSeptemba 2025. Ifumanise ukuba amazwe ali-126 kwali-135 anomgaqo-nkqubo okanye icebo elinye lorhulumente malunga ne-AI enoxanduva, nangona lo bambiselano lucutha ukuba luguqukele kukhuselo olunamandla; ulwazi nge-AI lube phakathi kwezibonakalisi ezisebenze kakuhle, amazwe ama-71, ipesenti 53, exela ukuba analo uhlaka olusebenzayo, ngokuchaseneyo namazwe ambalwa ngakumbi anamaziko ajongana nokubeka iliso ezizimeleyo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: I-AI enoxanduva, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo yintsika yesithandathu ye-Wits AHEAD, kwaye okufunyenwe kolu luhlu, ukuba imigaqo-nkqubo yolwazi nge-AI ihamba ngesantya esikhulu kunamaziko anamandla okuyinyanzelisa, kuchaza ngqo umsantsa wolawulo apho umsebenzi womgaqo-nkqubo weli qela ulinge ukuwuvala kwimfundo ephakamileyo kuMzantsi weHlabathi.

Global Center on AI Governance · Independent global governance research index
